name: Shackleton rim
description: Regional reference point on the Shackleton crater rim crest, derived from the LOLA 20 m DEM inside the NASA region 'Shackleton Rim' (Site04). Not a NASA-designated landing site.

name: Connecting ridge
description: Regional reference point: point CR1/C1 on the Shackleton - de Gerlache connecting ridge used in NASA Lunar Surface Data Book traverse examples. Not a NASA-designated landing site.

name: de Gerlache rim
description: Regional reference point: centre of the LOLA 5 m DEM region 'de Gerlache Rim 1' (Site11). Not a NASA-designated landing site.

name: Malapert massif
description: Regional reference point: centre of the LOLA 5 m DEM region 'Malapert Massif' (Site23). Not a NASA-designated landing site.

name: Haworth
description: Regional reference point: centre of the LOLA 5 m DEM region 'Haworth'. Not a NASA-designated landing site.

name: Shackleton inner wall (Site04 center)
description: Published centre of the LOLA 5 m DEM region 'Shackleton Rim' (Site04). It lies on the crater's inner wall (~31 deg slope), so it is kept only to show how sensitive light and Earth visibility are to the exact position. Not a NASA-designated landing site.
